entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 2 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: Sharpen your mind and engulf two foes in psionic flames. Always hits and crits. For every target you hit, gain a stack of Concentration, increasing your magical damage dealt by 30%, stacking to 6, and lasting 4 seconds.
notes: Applies Concentration! to the caster, increasing magical damage by 30% for 4 seconds.
Concentration! only stacks to 5, and increases magical damage by 30% at 1 stack, 120% at 2 stacks, 150% at 3 stacks, 180% at 4 stacks and 210% at 5 stacks.

entries.target: An long range attack that deals damage to yourself.

notes: Applies Mana Flow! to the caster, reducing mana costs by for 10 seconds.
Mana Flow! only stacks to 3, and reduces mana costs by 5% at 1 stack, 40% at 2 stacks and 50% at 3 stacks.
